% DSB overall architecture: BEVFusion (det + BEV seg) and FlashOCC (occ).
% Compile: pdflatex dsb_overview.tex  (or tectonic -X compile dsb_overview.tex)
\documentclass[tikz,border=8pt]{standalone}
\input{tikz_style.tex}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}

% ================================================================ inputs
\node[io, text width=3.2cm] (cam_in) at (0,17)
  {\textbf{6$\times$ Camera}\\3$\times$256$\times$704};
\node[io, text width=3.2cm] (lidar_in) at (0,8)
  {\textbf{LiDAR}\\$N\times5$ (x,y,z,i,t)};
\node[io, text width=3.6cm] (extr) at (0,12.5)
  {\textbf{Extrinsics / aug}\\camera2lidar $\cdot$ lidar2ego\\
   img\_aug $\cdot$ lidar\_aug};
\node[io, text width=3.6cm] (occ_in) at (0,2.5)
  {\textbf{6$\times$ Camera}\\7-tuple: imgs, sensor2ego,\\
   ego2global, $K$, post, bda};


% ================================================================ BEVFusion
\node[cam] (swin) at (4.6,17) {Swin-T\\+ GeneralizedLSSFPN};
\node[cam] (vt)   at (8.8,17) {DepthLSS / LSS\\view transform};
\node[io]  (cam_bev) at (13.2,17) {camera BEV\\80$\times$180$\times$180};

\node[lid] (vox)  at (4.6,8) {Voxelize\\0.075 m};
\node[lid] (scn)  at (8.8,8) {SparseEncoder\\spconv};
\node[io]  (lid_bev) at (13.2,8) {LiDAR BEV\\256$\times$180$\times$180};

\node[fus] (fuser) at (17.8,12.5) {ConvFuser\\80+256 $\to$ 256};
\node[fus] (decoder) at (22.0,12.5) {SECOND + SECONDFPN\\512$\times$180$\times$180};

\node[det, text width=3.0cm] (object) at (26.6,17) {\textbf{TransFusion} head\\3D detection};
\node[seg, text width=3.0cm] (map)    at (26.6,8)  {\textbf{BEV seg} head\\6-class map};

\draw[arr] (cam_in) -- (swin);
\draw[arr] (swin) -- (vt);
\draw[arr] (vt) -- (cam_bev);
\draw[arr] (lidar_in) -- (vox);
\draw[arr] (vox) -- (scn);
\draw[arr] (scn) -- (lid_bev);

\draw[arr] (cam_bev.east) -| (fuser.north);
\draw[arr] (lid_bev.east) -| (fuser.south);
\draw[arr] (fuser) -- (decoder);
\draw[arr] (decoder.east) -| (object.west);
\draw[arr] (decoder.east) -| (map.west);

% ================================================================ FlashOCC
\node[cam] (r50)   at (4.6,2.5) {ResNet-50\\+ CustomFPN};
\node[cam] (lss_occ) at (8.8,2.5) {LSSViewTransformer\\64$\times$200$\times$200};
\node[cam] (bevenc) at (13.4,2.5) {CustomResNet\\+ FPN\_LSS\\256$\times$200$\times$200};
\node[occ] (occhead) at (17.8,2.5) {BEVOCCHead2D\\$18\times16$ channels};

\draw[arr] (occ_in) -- (r50);
\draw[arr] (r50) -- (lss_occ);
\draw[arr] (lss_occ) -- (bevenc);
\draw[arr] (bevenc) -- (occhead);

% extrinsics bus (dashed) feeding both view transforms
\draw[darr] (extr.east) -- (2.0,12.5);
\draw[darr] (2.0,18.2) -- (2.0,3.6);
\node[tag, rotate=90] at (1.78,11.0) {geometry};
\draw[darr] (2.0,18.2) -| (8.8,17.75) -- (vt.north);
\draw[darr] (2.0,3.6)  -| (8.8,3.6)  -- (lss_occ.north);

% ================================================================ outputs
\coordinate (det_anchor) at (33,17);
\coordinate (seg_anchor) at (33,8);
\coordinate (occ_anchor) at (33,2.5);
\draw[arr] (object.east) -- (30.5,17);
\draw[arr] (map.east) -- (30.5,8);
\draw[arr] (occhead.east) -- (30.5,2.5);

% ---- detection output icon
\begin{scope}[shift={(det_anchor)}]
  \draw[fill=white, rounded corners=3pt, draw=inkA!40, line width=0.5pt]
    (-2.5,-2.2) rectangle (2.5,2.2);
  % camera strip
  \fill[black!12] (-2.3,0.45) rectangle (2.3,2.0);
  \draw[black!35] (-2.3,0.85) -- (2.3,1.05);
  \foreach \x/\c/\col in {-1.6/0.55/detA, -0.2/0.8/occA, 1.2/0.6/detA} {
    \draw[\col, line width=0.7pt]
      (\x,\c) rectangle ++(0.55,0.45);
    \draw[\col, line width=0.45pt]
      (\x+0.1,\c+0.1) -- ++(0.18,0.12) -- ++(0.2,-0.12);
  }
  \node[tag, anchor=north west] at (-2.3,0.4) {camera};
  % BEV panel
  \fill[black!82] (-2.3,-2.05) rectangle (0.75,-0.05);
  \foreach \x in {-2.2,-1.9,...,0.6} {
    \draw[black!45, line width=0.25pt] (\x,-2.05) -- (\x,-0.05);
  }
  \foreach \y in {-1.95,-1.65,...,-0.15} {
    \draw[black!45, line width=0.25pt] (-2.3,\y) -- (0.75,\y);
  }
  \foreach \x/\y/\c/\col in {-1.6/-1.5/0.42/detA, -0.2/-1.0/0.38/occA,
                             -1.0/-0.5/0.36/lidA, 0.0/-1.7/0.3/detA} {
    \draw[\col, line width=0.7pt] (\x,\y) rectangle ++(\c,\c);
  }
  \node[tag, anchor=north west] at (-2.3,-2.05) {BEV};
  \node[note, anchor=west, text width=1.55cm] at (0.95,-0.9)
    {\textbf{3D boxes}\\200 $\times$ (x,y,z,\\w,l,h,yaw)\\ + scores};
\end{scope}
\node[tag, anchor=north] at (33,14.6) {detection visualization};

% ---- segmentation output icon
\begin{scope}[shift={(seg_anchor)}]
  \draw[fill=white, rounded corners=3pt, draw=inkA!40, line width=0.5pt]
    (-2.5,-2.2) rectangle (2.5,2.2);
  \begin{scope}[shift={(-2.25,-2.0)}]
    \foreach \i in {0,...,9} {
      \foreach \j in {0,...,9} {
        \pgfmathsetmacro{\cx}{\i*0.32}
        \pgfmathsetmacro{\cy}{\j*0.32}
        \fill[black!8] (\cx,\cy) rectangle ++(0.30,0.30);
      }
    }
    % schematic classes: drivable / walkway / ped / divider / stop / carpark
    \foreach \i/\j in {1/1,2/1,1/2,2/2,3/2,2/3,3/3,4/3,3/4,4/4,5/4,4/5,5/5,6/5,5/6,6/6,7/6,6/7,7/7,7/8} {
      \fill[black!55] (\i*0.32,\j*0.32) rectangle ++(0.30,0.30);
    }
    \foreach \i/\j in {0/7,1/7,0/8,1/8,2/8,0/9,1/9,2/9} {
      \fill[segA!75] (\i*0.32,\j*0.32) rectangle ++(0.30,0.30);
    }
    \foreach \i/\j in {8/2,9/2,8/3,9/3,7/3,8/4} {
      \fill[lidA!70] (\i*0.32,\j*0.32) rectangle ++(0.30,0.30);
    }
    \foreach \i/\j in {4/0,5/0,4/1,5/1} {
      \fill[fusA!85] (\i*0.32,\j*0.32) rectangle ++(0.30,0.30);
    }
    \foreach \i/\j in {9/8,9/9,8/9} {
      \fill[black!25] (\i*0.32,\j*0.32) rectangle ++(0.30,0.30);
    }
  \end{scope}
  \node[note, anchor=west, text width=1.55cm] at (1.15,-0.9)
    {\textbf{BEV map}\\6 classes\\200$\times$200\\@ 0.5 m};
\end{scope}
\node[tag, anchor=north] at (33,5.6) {BEV segmentation visualization};

% ---- occupancy output icon (isometric voxel grid)
\begin{scope}[shift={(occ_anchor)}]
  \draw[fill=white, rounded corners=3pt, draw=inkA!40, line width=0.5pt]
    (-2.5,-2.2) rectangle (2.5,2.2);
  \begin{scope}[shift={(-0.55,-1.75)}, x={(0.52cm,0.24cm)}, y={(-0.52cm,0.24cm)}, z={(0cm,0.52cm)}]
    % cube faces
    \draw[occA!60, fill=occA!8] (0,0,0) -- (3,0,0) -- (3,3,0) -- (0,3,0) -- cycle;
    \draw[occA!60, fill=occA!14] (3,0,0) -- (3,3,0) -- (3,3,2) -- (3,0,2) -- cycle;
    \draw[occA!60, fill=occA!18] (0,0,0) -- (3,0,0) -- (3,0,2) -- (0,0,2) -- cycle;
    % grid
    \foreach \i in {1,2} {
      \draw[occA!35, line width=0.3pt] (\i,0,0) -- (\i,3,0);
      \draw[occA!35, line width=0.3pt] (0,\i,0) -- (3,\i,0);
      \draw[occA!35, line width=0.3pt] (3,\i,0) -- (3,\i,2);
      \draw[occA!35, line width=0.3pt] (\i,0,0) -- (\i,0,2);
      \draw[occA!35, line width=0.3pt] (\i,0,2) -- (\i,3,2);
      \draw[occA!35, line width=0.3pt] (0,\i,2) -- (3,\i,2);
    }
    % filled voxels
    \foreach \x/\y/\z in {0/1/0, 1/1/0, 1/2/0, 2/1/0, 0/0/1, 1/0/1, 2/2/0, 2/2/1} {
      \fill[occA!75] (\x,\y,\z) -- ++(1,0,0) -- ++(0,1,0) -- ++(-1,0,0) -- cycle;
      \fill[occA!55] (\x,\y,\z) -- ++(1,0,0) -- ++(0,0,1) -- ++(-1,0,0) -- cycle;
    }
  \end{scope}
  \node[note, anchor=west, text width=1.45cm] at (1.45,-1.0)
    {\textbf{Occupancy}\\200$\times$200$\times$16\\18 classes};
\end{scope}
\node[tag, anchor=north] at (33,-0.1) {occupancy visualization};

% ================================================================ groups / titles
\begin{scope}[on background layer]
  \node[grp, fit=(swin)(vt)(cam_bev)(vox)(scn)(lid_bev)(fuser)(decoder)(object)(map),
        label={[tag]above:BEVFusion \textbar{} camera + LiDAR}] {};
  \node[grp, fit=(r50)(lss_occ)(bevenc)(occhead),
        label={[tag]below:FlashOCC \textbar{} camera only}] {};
\end{scope}

\node[hdr] at (2.8,21.2) {DSB perception: BEVFusion (detection + BEV segmentation) and FlashOCC (occupancy)};
\node[note, anchor=north west, text width=28cm] at (-1.6,-3.0)
  {Grids: det 0.075 m voxel / 180$\times$180 BEV; seg 0.1 m voxel / 128$\times$128 BEV (+ 200$\times$200 map @ 0.5 m);
   occ 0.4 m / 200$\times$200$\times$16 occupancy. BEVFusion uses LiDAR + 6 cameras; FlashOCC is camera-only.};
\node[note, anchor=north west, text width=20cm] at (2.8,20.6)
  {BEVFusion: camera Swin-T + LSS/DepthLSS, LiDAR SparseEncoder, ConvFuser; det head TransFusion, seg head 6-class BEV.
   FlashOCC: ResNet-50 + LSS view transform + 2D BEV encoder + channel-to-height occupancy head.};

\end{tikzpicture}
